title: Purelight
description: Modpack that makes the game prettier. Nothing else.
body:
🖼️ About the pack

> Whether you're exploring forests with rippling foliage or watching voluminous clouds rushing across a sunset sky, this is the most beautiful Minecraft.

> But beauty doesn't have to come with lag. That's why every visual mod is combined with powerful optimization tools such as Sodium, Starlight, FerriteCore and others to ensure smooth gameplay even on medium systems.

⚙️ Performance-Boosting Mods Included
- Sodium, Iris, FerriteCore, Starlight, Indium, Entity Culling, LazyDFU, and more

🖥️ Recommended System Requirements
- RAM: 6–8 GB allocated
- GPU: GTX 1650 / RX 570 or better
- CPU: Quad-core 3GHz+

📸 Perfect for screenshots, roleplay servers, or just enjoying the view.
